en.headline: Police hunt three suspects after man stabbed in To Kwa Wan stairwell
en.dek: A 21-year-old man was attacked with a meat cleaver on San Lau Street on Monday evening and taken to hospital with a severe arm wound; the case is classified as wounding.
body: Police are searching for three men after a 21-year-old was stabbed in a stairwell in To Kwa Wan on Monday evening.

Officers received a report around 6pm from the victim, surnamed Lai, that he had been attacked by three men with a meat cleaver at a staircase on San Lau Street. He suffered severe bleeding to his arm and was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for treatment.

According to sources, the victim did not know the attackers. He had earlier argued with them over a debt at a unit in the building before the assault. The suspects fled the scene. Police have classified the case as wounding and no arrests have been made.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣樓梯間斬人案 警追三名疑兇
zh.dek: 一名21歲男子周一傍晚在新樓街樓梯間遭三名男子以肉刀襲擊，手臂重傷送院，案件列為傷人。
body: 警方正追查三名男子，因一名21歲男子周一傍晚在土瓜灣樓梯間被斬傷。
警方約下午6時接獲報案，事主姓黎，指在新樓街一樓梯間遭三名男子以肉刀襲擊，手臂嚴重出血，送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。
消息指事主不認識三名疑兇，較早前在大廈單位因債務爭執，其後被襲擊，疑兇逃離現場。警方將案件列為傷人，暫未有人被捕。
